evidence: Labeled 'Validation' and modifies `src/compressor.h`, which is used in UTXO serialization and chainstate integrity.
rationale: Prevents decompression failure from silently transforming unspendable scripts into anyone-can-spend scripts upon UTXO data corruption. The PR description notes that `ScriptCompression::Unser` currently ignores the `DecompressScript` return value, which 'in the worst-case scenario, which is currently only reachable through corruption, an unspendable off-curve P2PK turns into an anyone-can-spend empty script.'
